text_block_list.text:
AW YEEEAH! I have conquered the
summit of Mt.
Fujiii!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It pains me to say, but it appears I am
still one
step behind you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I thought I was going to
catch up,
but there was no stopping you
once your fire was
stoked... Well done.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Dang... I was so sure I was gonna win
today!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
You guys made for a formidable
mountain range!
My passion for climbing
got dialed to the max
thanks to you!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
We have fought many great battles
before, and
today was no exception.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: And now, I shall impart you with this.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I don't know what this Eden you seek is,
but I am
cheering for you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Is that the last clue for Eden?!
